paper_statement: For scale-invariant activation functions, the diagonal component of the NTK mean does not acquire any finite-width corrections.
quantifier: For every scalar sigma satisfying sigma(lambda z)=lambda sigma(z) for lambda>0, every k>=1, and every finite layer depth, the order-1/n^k correction is zero on x=x.
pass_condition: A machine-checkable algebraic induction proves the all-orders statement for arbitrary two-sided slopes; ReLU and LeakyReLU are explicit instances; independent Gaussian quadrature matches the required identities; GeLU fails the K-independence invariant as a negative control.

empirical_contract.architecture: bias-free four-layer standard/book-parametrized MLP with two output channels and C_W=2
empirical_contract.pass_condition: For every activation-width pair the diagonal mean is within four standard errors of the exact infinite-width recurrence and its two-sided 99% interval lies inside a one-percent relative equivalence margin. Every off-diagonal pair must detect a correction of at least one percent at five standard errors.
empirical_contract.estimator_deviation: Two unbiased parameter-space Hutchinson probes per network replace the source implementation's exact recursive Jacobian trace; an independent exact-Jacobian calibration must pass.
